title: Indikatori zlonamjerne aktivnosti
summary: Prepoznavanje indikatora iz logova i pcap-a: rogue uređaji, enumeracija, beaconing i DNS tunneling, LOLBins i sumnjivi procesi, eksfiltracija, cloud i identitetski indikatori (impossible travel, kompromitovan ključ), typosquatting i BEC.
summary_en: Recognizing indicators in logs and pcaps: rogue devices, enumeration, beaconing and DNS tunneling, LOLBins and suspicious processes, exfiltration, cloud and identity indicators (impossible travel, compromised key), typosquatting and BEC.
